title: The Diplomatic Envoy Eulerian Route
statement:
You are given a list of airline tickets where tickets[i] = [from_i, to_i] represent the departure and arrival airports of one flight.
Reconstruct the itinerary in order and return it.
All tickets belong to a man who departs from "JFK". Thus, the itinerary must begin with "JFK".
If there are multiple valid itineraries, you should return the itinerary that has the smallest lexical order when read as a single string.
You must use all the tickets once and only once.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N (number of tickets).
Next N lines: Two space-separated 3-letter uppercase airport codes (From To).
outputFormat: Print the complete itinerary airport codes separated by spaces.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000
Airport codes consist of 3 uppercase letters.

sampleCases.input:
4
MUC LHR
JFK MUC
SFO SJC
LHR SFO

5
JFK SFO
JFK ATL
SFO ATL
ATL JFK
ATL SFO
sampleCases.expectedOutput: JFK ATL JFK SFO ATL SFO
